plain.li: [faithdare_darerain] If your god is real, {OTHER}, let it rain before morning.
[faithdare_darerain] It hasn't rained in days, so let your god bring some by morning.
[faithdare_darerain] Rain by morning, {OTHER}, or I don't want to hear about your god again.
[faithdare_daresick] If your god cares at all, {SICK} will be up by morning.
[faithdare_daresick] Let's see your god get {SICK} out of bed by morning, then.
[faithdare_darelight] Nobody touches your god's light tonight, and we'll see if it's still burning at dawn.
[faithdare_darelight] If that light at your god's place is still going in the morning, I'll believe a little.
[faithdare_take] All right, {OTHER}, we'll go and look in the morning.
[faithdare_take] Fine, and when it comes you'll eat your words.
[faithdare_take] You're on, {OTHER}, but a god isn't a trick you can call up.
[faithdare_take,named] {GOD} doesn't need to prove anything to you, {OTHER}, but we'll see.
[faithdare_proud] There, {OTHER}, now what do you say?
[faithdare_proud] I told you, {OTHER}, and you saw it yourself.
[faithdare_proud,named] That was {GOD}, {OTHER}, and you know it.
[faithdare_shaken] I don't know what to make of that.
[faithdare_shaken] It could be chance, but I really didn't expect it.
[faithdare_quiet] It doesn't work like that, {OTHER}, and you know it.
[faithdare_quiet] A god doesn't jump when you tell it to.
[faithdare_pleased] Nothing, just as I said.
[faithdare_pleased] There you are, {OTHER}, nothing at all.
[faithdare_argue] You're looking at it the wrong way, {OTHER}.
[faithdare_argue] That isn't what it means, and you know it.
[faithdare_scoff] It proves nothing either way, {OTHER}.
[faithdare_scoff] That's chance, {OTHER}, nothing more.
[faithcamethrough_leave] This {WHAT} is yours now, for bringing me through.
[faithcamethrough_leave] I nearly didn't get up again, so I'm leaving this {WHAT} here.
[faithcamethrough_thanks] I came through it, and I know who to thank.
[faithcamethrough_thanks] I nearly didn't make it, so I wanted to come here first.
[faithcamethrough_thanks,named] {GOD} brought me through it, I'm sure of that.
[faithcamethrough_stand] I prayed to the same god while I worked on you, {OTHER}.
[faithcamethrough_stand] We both had help with that one, {OTHER}.
[faithcamethrough_glad] Good to see you up, {OTHER}, but take it easy for a few days.
[faithcamethrough_glad] You gave us a scare, {OTHER}, I'm glad you're on your feet.
[faithcamethrough_stitches] It was the stitches and the medicine, {OTHER}, but suit yourself.
[faithcamethrough_stitches] I did the work on you, {OTHER}, your god just watched.
[faithcamethrough_answer] Maybe it was both, {OTHER}.
[faithcamethrough_answer] You did your part, {OTHER}, and something else did the rest.
[faithsides_turn] That was my god's day today, {OTHER}, anyone could see it.
[faithsides_turn] You saw what happened today, {OTHER}, that was mine.
[faithsides_turn,named] That was {GOD}'s doing today, {OTHER}, and you know it.
[faithsides_answer] Your god had today, and you'll see what mine does tomorrow, {OTHER}.
[faithsides_answer] Wait a day or two and you'll see whose it really is, {OTHER}.
[faithsides_table] Sit down, both of you, and eat together for once.
[faithsides_table] Whatever the gods are doing, you two don't have to fight over it.
[faithsides_mend] Fine, {OTHER}, let the gods sort it out between themselves.
[faithsides_mend] I suppose we can leave the gods to it, {OTHER}.
[faithsides_cool] I'll sit, but I'm not changing my mind.
[faithsides_cool] I'll eat with you, {OTHER}, and that's all.
[ennuburying_true] {DEAD} was {DETAIL} once, long before coming here.
[ennuburying_true] Before all this, {DEAD} was {DETAIL}, did you know that?
[ennuburying_remember] I knew {DEAD} a little, a long time ago.
[ennuburying_remember] {DEAD} would be glad that someone came.
[ennuburying_who] How do you know that?
[ennuburying_who] Who are you, and where did you know them from?
[ennuburying_found] Someone left something on {DEAD}'s grave in the night.
[ennuburying_found] That wasn't on {DEAD}'s grave last night.
[faithlittleshrine_build] This is a house for the god, so it has somewhere to stay.
[faithlittleshrine_build] The big stone goes in the middle, like a real shrine.
[faithlittleshrine_build] Now the god has a place of its own, {OTHER}.
[faithlittleshrine_leave] And here's some food in case it gets hungry.
[faithlittleshrine_leave] Don't eat it, {OTHER}, it's for the god.
[faithlittleshrine_help] Here, a flat stone goes on top, like this.
[faithlittleshrine_help] That's a good place you've made, {OTHER}, let me help.
[faithlittleshrine_name] The book has pages about this god, and I'll read you some.
[faithlittleshrine_name] We have a name for this god in the book, and you've chosen well.
[faithlittleshrine_name,named] This is {GOD}'s place you've made, the book says so.
[faithlittleshrine_kick] Gods don't live in piles of stones.
[faithlittleshrine_kick] Stop wasting food on this, it's nonsense.
[faithlittleshrine_cry] You broke it, {OTHER}, we made that.
[faithlittleshrine_cry] Why did you do that, {OTHER}?
[faithlittleshrine_gone] The food at the children's little place is gone.
[faithlittleshrine_gone] Something took the food the children left out.
[faithturned_lay] This is all I kept of the old way, and now it's yours.
[faithturned_lay] I'm leaving this here so you know I mean it.
[faithturned_kneel] I'm here now, and I'm staying.
[faithturned_kneel] I don't know the words yet, but I'm here.
[faithturned_words] Who cometh in good faith is received, and the road behind is forgiven.
[faithturned_words] Thou art come to us, and that is enough.
[faithturned_words,named] {GOD} receiveth thee, and asketh not where thou hast been.
[faithturned_understand] I'd have done the same in your place, {OTHER}.
[faithturned_understand] I don't blame you, {OTHER}, it was a hard time.
[faithturned_betray] After everything, {OTHER}, you just walk away from it.
[faithturned_betray] That's a betrayal, {OTHER}, and you know it.
[faithturned_again] Think about it again before you go through with it, {OTHER}.
[faithturned_again] The old way will take you back, {OTHER}, if you ask.
[pipwake_keeper] The {WHAT} kept going longer than anyone thought it would.
[pipwake_keeper] I fixed that {WHAT} more times than I can count.
[pipwake_keeper] We won't find another {WHAT} like that one.
[pipwake_hum] It is gone to rest, and its work is not forgotten.
[pipwake_hum] Every wheel stoppeth at last, and is honoured for its turning.
[pipwake_hum,named] {GOD} keepeth the count of every turning, and this one is counted.
[pipwake_laugh] You're all standing round a broken {WHAT}, you know that?
[pipwake_laugh] It's scrap now, there's nothing here to mourn.
[pipwake_stand] I didn't think much of it, but it did its job.
[pipwake_stand] I'll stand here with you, it earned that much.
[faithtakenoffering_take] Nobody's going to miss it.
[faithtakenoffering_take] It's only going to waste here.
[faithtakenoffering_take] I'm sorry, but I'm so hungry.
[faithtakenoffering_saw] What are they doing at the god's place at this hour?
[faithtakenoffering_saw] Is that who I think it is?
[faithtakenoffering_tell] It wasn't the god, {OTHER}, {OFFENDER} took it, I saw them.
[faithtakenoffering_tell] I saw {OFFENDER} take it in the night, {OTHER}, no god came near it.
[faithtakenoffering_angry] {OFFENDER} did what, {OTHER}?
[faithtakenoffering_angry] I'll have a word with {OFFENDER} about that.
[faithtakenoffering_keep] I saw you at the god's place last night, {OTHER}, but I won't say anything.
[faithtakenoffering_keep] I know what you took, {OTHER}, and I'll keep it to myself.
[faithtakenoffering_thanks] Thank you, {OTHER}, I won't do it again.
[faithtakenoffering_thanks] Please don't tell anyone, {OTHER}.
[faithtakenoffering_shame] That was left for the god, {OTHER}, not for you.
[faithtakenoffering_shame] You let us all think the god took it, {OTHER}.
[faithtakenoffering_sorry] I know, {OTHER}, I'm sorry.
[faithtakenoffering_sorry] I wasn't thinking, {OTHER}, I'm sorry.
[faithbookread_read] Hear now the newest of what this house hath seen of the gods.
[faithbookread_read] Here is written what was seen, and I read it as it was set down.
[faithbookread_read] And it came to pass that a sign was seen, and those that saw it spake of it.
[faithbookread_read] So it is written, in the hand of the one who keepeth the book.
[faithbookread_read,named] Of {GOD} it is written thus, as it was told unto me.
[faithbookread_notso] That isn't how it happened, I was there.
[faithbookread_notso] You've written that wrong, {OTHER}, let me tell it.
[faithbookread_write] Tell it, and I shall set it down beside what is there.
[faithbookread_write] Then both tellings stand in the book, thine and the other.
[faithbookread_leave] I've heard enough of this for one night.
[faithbookread_leave] Read that to someone who believes it.
[faithweddingsign_blessrain] Rain on a wedding means a full house and a good harvest.
[faithweddingsign_blessrain] That rain's a blessing on the two of them, {OTHER}.
[faithweddingsign_warnrain] Rain on the vows is a bad sign, whatever you say, {OTHER}.
[faithweddingsign_warnrain] I don't like rain at a wedding, it means tears later.
[faithweddingsign_blesslight] The old light goes out so a new one can start, that's all it means.
[faithweddingsign_blesslight] A light put out for them, {OTHER}, that's a good sign where I come from.
[faithweddingsign_warnlight] A light going out at a wedding, I don't like that at all.
[faithweddingsign_warnlight] That's a warning, {OTHER}, mark my words.
[faithweddingsign_blesssign] Did you see that, the gods are glad for them.
[faithweddingsign_blesssign] That was a blessing on them, {OTHER}, plain as day.
[faithweddingsign_blesssign,named] {GOD} has blessed this wedding, I'm sure of it.
[faithweddingsign_warnsign] Something is watching this wedding, and I don't know if it's pleased.
[faithweddingsign_warnsign] I'd be careful, {OTHER}, signs cut both ways.
[faithraiderword_words] Go thou to thy rest, for thy people and mine pray alike.
[faithraiderword_words] Whatever thou didst here, another than us judgeth thee now.
[faithraiderword_words,named] {GOD} take thee, for thou wast {GOD}'s as I am.
[faithraiderword_bury] Bury this one, don't burn the body or leave it for the animals.
[faithraiderword_bury] This one held the same god as me, so we should put them in the ground.
[faithraiderword_nod] All right, we'll bury them.
[faithraiderword_nod] I don't like it, {OTHER}, but you're right.
[faithraiderword_angry] They came here to kill us, {OTHER}, and you want to pray for them?
[faithraiderword_angry] Say your words, {OTHER}, but I'm not digging a grave for them.
[faithgift_leave] This is for {FRIEND}'s god, I owe them that much.
[faithgift_leave] I was wrong to say what I said to {FRIEND}.
[faithgift_stand] I said things to {FRIEND} that I shouldn't have.
[faithgift_stand] Whatever I think of this god, {FRIEND} didn't deserve that from me.
[faithgift_thanks] You left something at my god's place, {OTHER}, I saw.
[faithgift_thanks] That was good of you, {OTHER}.
[faithgift_sorry] I'm sorry about the other day, {OTHER}.
[faithgift_sorry] Let's not fight about the gods again, {OTHER}.
[faithgift_disloyal] Giving gifts to another god now, {OTHER}?
[faithgift_disloyal] I didn't think you'd go over to them, {OTHER}.
[faithbargain_accuse] Nothing touches you lately, {OTHER}, so what did you promise for that?
[faithbargain_accuse] That kind of luck has a price, {OTHER}, and I think you paid it.
[faithbargain_accuse] Something out there is looking after you, {OTHER}, and it isn't a god.
[faithbargain_own] I was desperate, {OTHER}, and something answered.
[faithbargain_own] Yes, I made a bargain, {OTHER}, and I'd do it again.
[faithbargain_deny] I made no bargain with anything, {OTHER}.
[faithbargain_deny] It's luck, {OTHER}, that's all it is.
[faithbargain_defend] Leave them alone, {OTHER}, you've no right to say that.
[faithbargain_defend] That's a terrible thing to say to anyone, {OTHER}.
[faithbargain_vigil] Come and sit with me tonight at the god's place, {OTHER}.
[faithbargain_vigil] You shouldn't be alone with this, {OTHER}, come with me.
[faithlightning_storm] It was the storm, nothing more, lightning has to land somewhere.
[faithlightning_storm] Lightning hits whatever stands out in the open, that's all.
[faithlightning_test] This is a test, and we'll put it right.
[faithlightning_test] Something is testing us, and we'll answer it.
[faithlightning_test,named] {GOD} is testing us, and we'll put it right.
[faithlightning_rival] That was my god's answer to all your offerings, {OTHER}.
[faithlightning_rival] You know whose that was, {OTHER}, and it wasn't the weather's.
[faithlightning_rebuild] We'll build it again together, {OTHER}, better than before.
[faithlightning_rebuild] Come on, {OTHER}, let's put it right.
